title: A keep scalar replaced by a mapping leaves the comment line after it a comment
notes: A keep scalar ends where the next line is less indented, and a comment line after it is not part of its value. The new mapping is written on the lines after the key, and the comment line stays a comment on its own line: it is not a comment at the end of the key line, and it is not taken as text of the new value.

provenance.reference: Found by comparing random edits of random documents with a plain model while building a lossless document for a Python library.
